# Typecast

Typecast is an AI voice platform for generating expressive speech, discovering voices, and managing custom voices.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/typecast/.

## Actions

- **Compose Speech**: Generate one audio file from an ordered sequence of speech and pause segments.
- **Generate Speech**: Generate a complete WAV or MP3 audio file from text using a Typecast voice.
- **Generate Speech With Timestamps**: Generate speech plus word, character, or both alignment timestamp arrays.
- **Get Subscription** (read-only): Get the connected Typecast API plan, credit usage, concurrency limit, and custom-voice allowance.
- **Get Voice** (read-only): Get one voice's metadata, supported models, and available emotions by voice ID.
- **List Voices** (read-only): List available built-in and owned custom Typecast voices, optionally filtered by speech model, gender, age, use case, and voice type.
- **Recommend Voices** (read-only): Find and rank Typecast voices that match a natural-language description.
